k:病.mnemonic: A person kept on a sickbed (疒) by something wrong deep inside (内), where the doctor cannot see it. Sickness (ill, disease, sick).

k:犬.mnemonic: A big person with arms spread wide, and a small dot by the shoulder: the pet jumping up at its owner's side. Dog.
k:犬.hint: A pet leaping at its owner's shoulder.

k:状.mnemonic: A dog (犬) lying on its plank (爿) by the door, where it lay yesterday and will lie tomorrow. Nothing has changed. Status quo (conditions, circumstances, form).
k:状.hint: Same dog, same plank, every day.

k:亡.mnemonic: A lid over a corner where someone is tucked away out of sight: hidden behind a screen and no longer with us. Deceased (the late, dying, perish).

k:登.mnemonic: Carry your tent (癶) and a pot of beans (豆) up the mountain: food and shelter on your back, step by step upward. Ascend (climb up).

k:各.mnemonic: They trudge (夂) in one by one, and every single mouth (口) gets a bowl of its own. Each (every, either).

k:武.mnemonic: A man who can stop (止) a charging horse with nothing but a tent peg (弋) in his fist. Warrior (military, chivalry, arms).
k:武.hint: Halting a horse with a peg.

k:居.mnemonic: The clerk has been at the bureau (局) for ten (十) years and never seems to go home: he practically lives at his desk. Reside (to be, exist, live with).
k:居.hint: The clerk who lives at his desk.

k:庁.mnemonic: Under the canopy (广) is the counter where forms become complete (了): stamped, signed and filed. Government office.
k:庁.hint: The counter where forms get stamped.

k:冊.mnemonic: Bamboo slats standing side by side with a cord through the middle binding them: an ancient bound book. Tome (volume).

k:編.mnemonic: Behind a closed door (戸), loose pages are sewn with thread (糸) into a single tome (冊): many writings bound as one. Compilation (knit, plait, braid).

k:室.mnemonic: Under the roof (宀), at the climax (至) of the corridor where it comes to its end, there is a door. Everyone has gone (去) inside and shut it. Room (apartment, chamber, cellar).
k:室.hint: The door at the corridor's end.

k:競.mnemonic: Two of them stand (立) side by side, each one an elder brother (兄), each on tiptoe trying to be the taller. Compete (emulate, bid).

k:斉.mnemonic: A row of stalks under a lid, trimmed so the tops come out even, with two long legs set level beneath. Adjusted (alike, equal).
k:斉.hint: Stalks trimmed to an even line.

k:済.mnemonic: After the tsunami (氵) the accounts are adjusted (斉), every debt squared and washed away. It is all settled. Finish (settle, relieve, come to an end).

k:術.mnemonic: Go (行) to the tree (木) ten (十) times a day and practise your sword strokes on it: that is how a technique is learned. Art (technique, skill, means).
k:術.hint: Daily sword practice on a trunk.

k:配.mnemonic: A cobra (已) guards the wine jar (酉) and lets every guest take exactly one cup, no more: everyone gets a share. Distribute (deliver, arrange, spouse).
k:配.hint: One cup each from the guarded jar.

k:込.mnemonic: A winding road with a figure wedging itself into the last gap on it: so full that people have to squeeze in. Crowded (mixture, in bulk, included).

k:丘.mnemonic: An axe (斤) left standing on one (一) flat line of ground: it has cleared every tree and only the bare rise remains. Hill (knoll).
k:丘.hint: An axe on a cleared rise.

k:兵.mnemonic: The hill (丘) has sprouted fins (ハ), a pair of marching legs: troops swarm over it so thickly that the hill itself seems to march. Soldier (private, troops, army).
k:兵.hint: A whole hillside on the march.

k:料.mnemonic: Rice (米) is measured out with a ladle shaped like the Big Dipper (斗): so many scoops is what you owe. Fee (materials).

k:秋.mnemonic: The grain (禾) is cut and fire (火) burns off the stubble, while the leaves turn the colour of flame. Autumn.

k:城.mnemonic: Soil (土) is piled and rammed until it becomes (成) a rampart, then walls, then towers. Castle.

k:造.mnemonic: A revelation (告) on the path (辶): halfway through a walk the idea arrives, and you rush home to make it. Create (make, structure, physique).

k:陸.mnemonic: A mound (阝) appears on the horizon, then soil (土) upon soil, and at last the sailors' legs (儿) are standing on something solid. Land (six).

k:仕.mnemonic: A samurai (士) stands at the side of his leader (亻), ready to do whatever is asked of him. Attend (doing, official, serve).
k:仕.hint: A samurai waiting on his lord.

k:愛.mnemonic: A claw (爪) gently strokes a forehead (冖), the heart (心) swells underneath, and you would trudge (夂) any distance for them. Love (affection, favourite).
k:愛.hint: A gentle stroke, a swelling heart.

k:格.mnemonic: They trudge (夂) to the great tree (木), where a mouth (口) calls out who sits on which branch, high or low. Status (rank, capacity, character).
k:格.hint: Assigned a branch, high or low.

k:技.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) that can support (支) a spinning plate on a twig: that takes years of practice. Skill (art, craft, ability).
k:技.hint: Spinning a plate on a twig.
